description: Dedicated dashboard for Pi Zero 2W nodes only (excludes control plane)

targets.expr: label_replace(  (node_wifi_station_signal_dbm{instance=~".*pi.*"} and on(instance) up{job="node-exporter"} == 1)  or ((up{job="node-exporter", instance=~".*pi.*"} == 0) - 100),  "hostname", "$1", "instance", "([^.:]+).*")
topk(15, sum by (pod, namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",container!="POD"}) * on(pod, namespace) group_left(node) kube_pod_info)

label_replace(  (clamp_max(clamp_min((node_wifi_station_signal_dbm{instance=~".*pi.*"} + 70) * 100 / 40, 0), 100) and on(instance) up{job="node-exporter"} == 1)  or (up{job="node-exporter", instance=~".*pi.*"} == 0) * 0,  "hostname", "$1", "instance", "([^.:]+).*")

targets.legendFormat: {{instance | split(":") | first | split(".") | first}} RX packets/s

title: Pi Zero 2W Monitor (Pi Nodes Only)
